note: Both sets contain the same fabricated claim of an equivalent driveshaft linear-stiffness of 7,000 N·m/rad and several vague 'drivetrain' bindings (speed, efficiency, gear ratio). Set A covers the full Table 5-1 property set including rated rotor speed 12.1 rpm and the DOWEC generator inertia facts (5,025,500 kg·m²) and keeps the DOWEC power-loss conditions, all of which Set B omits. However, Set A adds clear errors Set B avoids: a misread 'free-free mode natural frequency = 5% critical' (5% critical is the damping ratio) and a misbound 'generator speed shaft' inertia claim. On balance A's fuller, faithful coverage of the drivetrain properties outweighs its one extra misread, though B is close.
